notes: Film: easier layering. Split clips that were inside another layer no longer go invisible. Right-click › Put inside lists every layer (with times), and in Layers you can drop one layer onto the middle of another to put it inside. Right-click › Order: bring to front, forward, backward, send to back. Drag a clip onto the ruler (new top track) or the empty space under the tracks (new bottom track). Clips can't hide under each other on one track any more. New tools under the picture: Move (V), Rotate, Scale, Pivot (P, move the point it turns around), Razor (C, click a clip to cut it), Text, Rectangle and Ellipse (drag to draw), Hand and Zoom (Z). The graph redraws at its real size, and the value window can be dragged anywhere and stays there.

Fandom imposter: Easy/Normal/Hard difficulty (Hard: the imposter only knows the topic and bluffs, 1-word clues), word topics (places & scenes, food, animals, jobs, things, things to do, random) and your own word list, choose how many clues a person sends per turn, Enter sends your clue, Skip button, every clue stays visible beside your card, the imposter never goes first, and secrets don't repeat game after game.

Film: new 🪟 View menu to set up your layout: graph under the timeline, beside the tracks or in its own window; value window floating, in the right panel or off; show or hide the layers, settings and timeline; swap the side panels. Click any setting's name to open its little window: colour wheel for colours, 360° dial for turns, position pad, slider for the rest (a 🎨 button opens the wheel too). Grab a track's name on the timeline and drag it up or down to put it in front of or behind other layers.

Film: put things inside other things. Pick a layer and choose Stay inside (or right-click › Put inside), and it only shows within that layer's shape, like text inside a star, without moving or turning with it. Click a keyframe and its own editor opens over the picture: a 360° dial for rotation with Flat, Tilt and Turn (3D) axes, a pad with the motion path for position, and a slider for everything else. New Tilt and Turn 3D values. Clicking a value's row (rotate, size, X/Y) makes dragging the picture do that, with tool buttons on the preview. Rotating keeps counting past a full turn.

Film Motion editor rebuilt. One keyframe system: every value has its own track (like After Effects), so nothing snaps back and moves play smoothly when you play or scrub. Old films are converted when opened. Timeline: playhead lines up with the ruler, tracks open (▸) to show each animated value, drag / pick / copy / paste / duplicate / delete keyframes, trim clips from both ends, snapping (🧲). Graph editor now sits under the timeline with bézier handles. Each clip has its own effect list (add, reorder, turn off, keyframe every setting) with new effects: glow, drop shadow, outline, directional blur, RGB split, wave, gradient, circle and box masks. Picture handles to resize and rotate, guides that snap to the middle and edges, Ctrl+click to move several. Layers: drag to reorder, double-click to rename, duplicate, delete. Clip transitions (fade, slide, zoom, blur, wipe), sound fade in / out, and a Media tab with everything you imported.

1.20.2: Motion editor: rotation and other values work again on clips that had a whole-clip keyframe (and R rotates); the whole editor turns dark and pro while Motion is on, with a settings rail on the right, coloured clips and show / hide and lock on each track.

1.20.1: Rig Builder gets the new rig tools: a Turn dial to try turnarounds, picture by angle (front / ¾ / side, mirrored, shifted), expression and gesture sets, turn limits for joints and bones, and an axis editor with exact numbers. Sets and Turn are saved in .fandom files and go into Film with the rig.

1.20.0: Better rigs: a new starter puppet (shaded, a head that turns front / ¾ / side, 10 eyes, 11 mouth shapes, 5 hand poses), a Turn dial on every rig, pictures that change by angle (by a part's own turn or the Turn dial, mirrored and shifted), expression / gesture sets (one click changes eyes + mouth or both hands), rotation limits so elbows and knees bend the right way, and an axis editor (exact joint, pivot and turn).

1.19.0: Film's Motion mode is now its own editor: a layers panel (show / hide, lock), shapes (rectangle, circle, star, polygon, triangle, heart, line) with fill, gradient, border, shadow and glow, blending modes, setting groups like Alight Motion with a ◆ keyframe on every value, a row per animated value on the timeline, and a graph editor with easing presets and custom curves. Shortcuts: Alt+1–7 shapes, F2–F9 groups, H hide, G graph.

1.18.1: Film timeline: left-drag a box to pick clips (move, copy, delete them together; Ctrl+G groups them into one clip, Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups), right-drag a box to pick keyframes (red ticks too): Delete, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V.

1.18.0: Film gets Motion mode (✨ Motion in the toolbar): one-click animations on the beat (bounce, head bop, squash & stretch, zoom punch, shake, wiggle, spin, jump…), pop / slide / drop / spin-in, BPM with tap tempo and beat lines on the timeline, and text that animates letter by letter. Rig bones can now be moved, not just turned, so heads can bounce.

1.17.18: Mall finds a lot more: the store searches work again (Etsy, eBay, BoxLunch, Redbubble, TeePublic…), 13 more stores and knock-off sites, Makeship, and a character's name finds listings that don't name the show.

1.17.17: Guess who remade: pick your own character, every picked fandom mixed on the board, ask one question per turn and the other player answers Yes / No / Not sure, guessing only after 3 questions, and your character stays secret on your own app.
1.17.16: Speed spelling gives points by the word: get part of the name (Wendy of Wendy Corduroy) and you still score that share of 500.

1.17.15: New party game Guess who (2 players, rest of the call watches). Speed spelling: Skip button, right words fill in one by one, main characters only. Leave any party game (Rejoin anytime); the game ends when everyone else has left.

1.17.14: Command Prompt gets real commands: UPDATE (and UPDATE CHECK), APPS, KILL, FANDOM SET, SEARCH, WIKI, CALC, TIMER, ROLL, FLIP, SETTINGS, ONLINE, ERRORS, TICKET, HISTORY, UPTIME, RESTART. VER shows the real version.

1.17.13: Party games: Fandom imposter and Speed spelling join the party quiz, with one shared setup (saved picks, characters, timing). Only one person sets up at a time; idle 40s closes it. Quizer: whole pictures (not cropped), next picture loads ahead, waits for Next, saved picks always there.

1.17.12: Quizzes only use real characters (no wiki pages, teams, techniques, actors, crowd or cover pictures). Party quiz: one at a time, fandoms in random order, no repeats, everyone's fandoms from the call, well-known or every character, saved fandom picks. Calls: each person's volume, mute for you, and focus.
1.17.11: Call relay accepts an address without turn: in front (like free.expressturn.com:3478) and no longer says Saved when the address was thrown away.
1.17.10: Quizer grows with its window (maximized it's about 1.6x bigger).
1.17.9: Remove owner from other owner accounts (👑 Staff). 🔁 Accounts suggests people with their pictures as you type. Run Update the server once.

1.17.8: Owner panel › 🔁 Accounts gives people (or you) their old account back; the empty account is deleted after a day and can be undone until then. Error popups get a 🎫 Send a ticket button. Run Update the server once.

1.17.7: devices no longer get signed out (and onto a new empty account) just because their device record went missing. Owner can give someone their old account back (profile › 🔁 Give back their old account…). Run Update the server once.

Get your old chat account back: if a device lost its sign-in and got a new empty account, the owner opens the Owner patch and the app offers to go back to the older owner account (chats, friends and groups return). Also: a device that gets signed out now asks before starting a new empty account instead of doing it silently. The owner needs Settings > Online > Update the server first.

Fix: chat could fail to connect with 'The chat server needs an update first' and a 'Slow down' warning. A new chat account with its own profile picture tried to upload the picture before the profile existed, which the server refuses; it now makes the profile first, then uploads the picture (and still lets you in if the picture fails).
Picture searches load more as you scroll: keep scrolling down in Find a picture (profile, fandom and OC pictures), stickers and chat GIFs and the next page of results loads by itself.

Moderation: every message in Everything they wrote has See the conversation (the chat before and after it, any chat or DM, live), and nudges, songs, voice clips and files show what they are instead of a blank box. Reports get a Live chat around it button. Fandom edits (name, icon, logo) now show in the fandom list and apply after a restart. Chat: reply to a message (hover and press the reply arrow, or right-click and pick Reply); the reply shows a quote you can click to jump to the original. The owner needs Settings > Online > Update the server for the new moderation parts.

Songs, voice clips, pictures and documents sent in Chatroom now really become links. The free host (qu.ax) refuses some file names (.mp3, .wav, .ogg, .m4a, .docx…): songs now go up under a video name and still play as songs, and other refused files go up inside a .zip with the real file in it. One refused file no longer sends the next 10 minutes of uploads to your own storage.

Storage check: the owner's media log now marks every picture as 🔗 Link (no space) or 💾 On your storage. If the free file hosts are ever down and an upload has to be saved on your own storage, the sender now gets a notice instead of it happening silently.

Everything sent in Chatroom is now a link: pictures, drawings, voice messages, PDFs and other documents go to the free outside host (catbox, or qu.ax while catbox is paused), like GIFs, videos and songs already did, so they use no chat server storage. Up to 200 MB. Programs and scripts (.exe, .bat and so on) can't be sent. Device links fixed: 'That link could not be made' happened when your OS was over the 8 MB a link can carry; links are now compressed, and if still too big the biggest parts stay behind (Settings says which).

Lite mode: when the chat server is full (about 200 live connections on the free plan), extra people still chat in lite mode, with new messages arriving every few seconds instead of instantly. Idle people (5 minutes without touching anything, not in a call) step down to lite and give their slot away; active lite people take a free slot back within about 45 seconds. A 🐢 Lite mode tag shows in Chatroom. New Settings › Devices tab: every phone and computer signed in to your account, with rename, sign out, and the one-time link to add a device. Owner: run Settings › Online › Update the server once for the device list.

Chat: links to YouTube, TikTok, Streamable, Vimeo, Twitch clips, Google Drive, GIFs, pictures, videos and songs now play or show right in the message. GIFs, videos and songs you send become links again: catbox.moe has paused uploads, so they now go to qu.ax (kept a year) when catbox is down, and only fall back to the chat server if both are down.

GIFs, videos and songs always send now. The free outside host (catbox.moe) has paused uploads, so when it's down they go to the chat server's own storage instead (up to 25 MB), and it's tried again every 10 minutes.

Chat: GIFs, videos and songs you send now go to a free outside host as a link, so they take no space on the chat server (up to 200 MB each). Normal pictures, voice messages and other files still stay on the chat server, because outside links are public and can't be deleted.
Chatroom: uploads that were cleaned up no longer show a 'cleared' note. Those messages simply disappear from the chat (and from the fan feed), so it stays tidy.

The taskbar volume and Mute now control every sound and video in the OS (they only changed the OS's own sounds before). Chat: songs and videos sent as files play right in the message; sending the same file again within a minute asks first, and an Uploading… line shows while it goes up. Files removed by a clean-up now say they were cleared instead of looking like they're still there. Fan feed @mentions are checked once a minute, which saves the chat server's free live updates. Toks: double-tap to like with a big heart, hearts burst when you like, Save and Share pop with a note, Nope swipes the Tok away, and the name and buttons slide in. Owner: run Update the server.

The fan feed no longer uses the chat server's storage at all: GIFs from the GIF picker are posted as links, and pictures you upload go to a free outside host (like videos), so only the link is kept. Chats, DMs and profile pictures still use the chat server's storage.

Fan feed: post a picture, GIF or video by pasting its link with the new 🔗 Media link button. YouTube, TikTok, Streamable, Vimeo, Twitch clips, Google Drive and Imgur play right in the post, and none of it uses the chat server's space. Video files (up to 200 MB) are posted through a free outside host, so only the link is kept. Owner: run Update the server.

Upload limits: everyone can upload 10 files every 10 minutes, with a warning before the limit (uploads cost server money). Cloudflare storage stops at a cap (9 GB, under the free 10 GB) so it never charges; the owner can change it in Manage › Storage. Owner: run Update the server, then copy the new Worker code from Manage › Storage into Cloudflare.

Calls fixed: when both people started the call at the same moment it could get stuck on 'connecting…' for ever (both of you need this version). Calls between any two networks: the owner can turn on a Cloudflare call relay for everyone (Settings › Online). New badges: a new admin shield, a new moderator shield, and the old admin badge is now for content creators (owner picks them in Manage › Staff; a badge only, no powers).

GIFs picked from the picture search now keep moving (app icons, profile pictures and more). Screenshots: Win+Shift+S works on the first press (Shift was getting lost, so it often opened Start instead), and Print Screen is caught by the app so Windows can't take it first.

Support tickets are now conversations: write back and forth with the owner, and you get a notification when they answer. Owner: each ticket has Go to them, Everything they wrote (all their chat, DM, post and comment messages in one place, searchable), Time out and Ban. The 'Running inside Fandom Crazy OS' pop-up for computer apps has a Don't show again button. Change icon for built-in apps can now search the web for a picture too.
Apps imported from your computer: right-click > Change icon to search the web for a picture (or upload one) and crop it. Back to its own icon undoes it.

Updates: checked on the startup screen (Y/N, Yes after 10 seconds) with live download and install progress, and a progress bar when you update from the desktop. Only the newest version is on GitHub now. Moderation: reports keep the conversation around them; 5 reports in a minute mutes for 10 minutes; owner media log (every picture and GIF); bans wipe the account's chat history and stop device links. Support tickets in Settings > Help & support. Fan feed: stories (1 day), GIFs, @mentions with notifications, pick fandoms, anti-spam. Quizer: songs play, new Guess the Clip quiz. Readable fandom picker, better wiki search. Owner: run Update the server once.

Your devices (Settings > Profile): sign your phone, Mac or another PC in to your account with a one-time link that copies everything over. Choose how long it works (10 minutes to 1 week). It works once and is encrypted, and each device gets its own sign-in. Owner: run Settings > Online > Update the server once to install it.

Profile pictures: search the web or upload, then crop (first start-up, Settings > Profile and the Chatroom profile and banner). Tutorials: every app offers a short tour the first time you open it, with a welcome tour for new users. Skip any of them; find them all, with search, in Settings > Tutorials. Owner: Chatroom > Manage > Fandoms edits any fandom for everyone (name, icon, logo, wallpaper, add/hide/re-picture characters, app pictures). Run Update the server once.

Uploads can now be kept forever on Cloudflare R2 (owner: Chatroom > Manage > Storage has the steps). Pictures are shrunk to WebP. New owner clean-up: delete uploads older than X days, weeks, months or years, or between two dates, by kind, and it shows how many files and how much space first. Automatic clean-up can be turned off. Only the owner can change the chat server, invites or call relay. Owners: run Settings > Online > Update the server once.

Icon styles (Settings > Appearance > Icons): Default (characters), Bland (plain icons that match the theme's colour, or pick your own colour for all), Randomized (random pictures of the fandom's characters with a progress bar, Re-roll and Reset), and Classic.

Emoji: Fandom Crazy sticker emoji with a white edge and shadow, which wiggle when you point at them and pop in when sent alone. Search for any emoji by name in the emoji picker (cat, party, cry…) across all 1,900 emoji. Hover an emoji to see its name.

Fandom search: the real wiki comes first again. Example: Sally Face had been picking a near-empty copy (sallyface.fandom.com, 3 characters) instead of sally-face.fandom.com (62 characters). If a fandom looks almost empty, pick it again from the fandom picker.

Faster pictures: image search and wallpaper search used to wait 15+ seconds for a picture site that never answers. Results now come in about half a second, and the pictures are the same as before. Change icon now shows every character of the fandom (Sally Face: 62), whole instead of cut off.

Emoji: Fandom Crazy now has its own emoji set everywhere, the same on every computer and phone, instead of Windows emoji. Change it in Settings > Appearance > Emoji: colourful, retro black-and-white outline, or the computer's own.

Cursor Maker: draw your own cursor pixel by pixel (Settings > Cursor & Effects > Make my own cursor). Animation frames, onion skin, speed, click point, mirror, outline, recolour, picture or GIF import, and a separate link cursor. Your cursor also goes into the Windows cursor pack export. The emoji next to the themed cursor is gone.

Chatroom: back to the normal look by default (Classic 2005 is in Options > Look). Staff badges are drawn icons now, and nobody can fake them with emoji in their name. Only the app owner can rename fandom servers or add/change their channels. Banning works again. Quizer: mix several fandoms, or press Every fandom. Party quiz: pick your own fandoms. Fandoms: every character from the wiki, a stronger search, and an Import from a link button. Updates: the popup lists every version you missed. Owners: run Settings > Online > Update the server once.

Chatroom: new classic 2005 messenger look (text tabs, Name says:, square buttons, words instead of emoji), switchable in Options > Look with font, text size, pictures, your message colour and chat background. Kicks now take effect live: the person is thrown out right away and can't rejoin for 10 minutes. Reports list everyone who reported a message. Owners: run Settings > Online > Update the server once for kicks to stick.

Chat fixes: deleting someone else's message (as owner or staff) now removes it right away for everyone, and you get an error if it couldn't be deleted. Owners: the Clean up now error (column reference key is ambiguous) is fixed after you run Settings > Online > Update the server once.

Chatroom: new messages now show up by themselves (it also checks every few seconds, so a dropped live connection on phones no longer means reopening the chat). Phone: servers are a row along the top and the channel list stays visible above the chat, so you can switch channels.

Android: picture viewer and crop buttons no longer hide behind the phone's own Back/Home buttons or status bar. New: Settings › Desktop › Phone buttons lets you choose a three-button bar, gesture line, or no room.

Android: the app now joins the built-in chat server by itself, with no invite code. Android: your whole OS (settings, files, chat account) is backed up to the chat server every minute, so uninstalling and reinstalling brings everything back on the same account. Tip: to update on Android, just open the new APK and install it over the old app; you don't need to uninstall first, and nothing is lost.

Fandom wallpapers now load right away on Windows, Linux and Android: a real wallpaper is picked first instead of the wiki's mostly-blank page background. The apps now check for updates every minute (it won't ask twice about the same version). Android: no second Back/Home/Apps bar above the phone's own buttons; All apps and Recent apps are in the dock. Phone layouts reworked for Studio, Film, Rig Builder, Paint, OC Maker, OC Playground, Photo Booth, Tier List, Episode Tracker, File Explorer and Everything: toolbars slide sideways instead of squashing, editors scroll as one column with the picture pinned on top.

Notifications: chat messages now land in the 🔔 Notifications list and pop up; clicking one (or its pop-up) opens that exact conversation. Chatroom is in Settings › Notifications (on by default). The OS's own little messages are kept in the list too.

OC Playground: import .fandom rigs (and .oc files) as characters with the new Import button. Characters can now Spin (turn to the side or away), Tip forward or back, and move Further back (smaller, higher up, drawn behind), on top of Turn.

Auto-updates: from this version on, Fandom Crazy OS checks for a new version every time it starts and asks before updating. Also: finds small fandom wikis Fandom's own search misses, paste any fandom.com wiki link, and a fandom only finishes loading once its wallpaper actually shows.
